name: seal-account-manager
description: Portable Roblox account manager with multi-instance launching, playtime insights, custom performance presets, activity tracking, and client customization

scripts.build:portable: npm run build:native && electron-builder --win portable && npm run test:portable
scripts.build:all: npm run build:native && electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.test:stability: node scripts/test-mutex-lifecycle.js && node scripts/test-server-hub-state.js && electron scripts/test-account-store-recovery.js && electron scripts/test-account-store-ui.js
scripts.test:launch-ui: node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-launch-splash-ui.js && electron scripts/test-unlinked-sessions-ui.js && electron scripts/test-launch-preparation-ui.js
scripts.test:badge-games: node scripts/test-badge-inventory.js && node scripts/test-owned-badge-api.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-badge-games-ui.js
scripts.test:metadata-routing: node scripts/test-game-metadata.js && node scripts/test-join-routing.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-metadata-routing-ui.js
scripts.test:metadata-speed: node scripts/test-metadata-speed.js && node scripts/test-badge-icon-cache.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-metadata-speed-ui.js
scripts.test:background: node scripts/test-background-mode.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-background-ui.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-background-ui.js --network-stalled
scripts.test:background-recovery: node scripts/test-current-activity.js && node scripts/test-presence-timeout.js && node scripts/test-session-recovery.js
scripts.test:quiet-launch: node scripts/test-native-hidden.js && node scripts/test-quiet-launch.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-quiet-launch-ui.js
scripts.test:badge-dates: node scripts/test-badge-award-dates.js && node scripts/test-award-dates-api.js && node scripts/run-electron-test.js scripts/test-badge-dates-ui.js
